web_results.title: Multi-parameter optimization: identifying high quality compounds with a balance of properties (review)
web_results.snippet: Drug discovery review explaining how individual property scores (potency, solubility, ADME, toxicity) are turned into per-property desirability scores and then combined into a single 'desirability index' by adding, averaging, or taking the geometric mean. Directly maps to M87's idea of fusing solubility/toxicity/activity/Lipinski into one ranking number; clarifies why a weighted/desirability combination beats hard cutoffs.

web_results.title: Weighted Scoring Model Framework - Steps and Example
web_results.snippet: Beginner-friendly walkthrough of the weighted scoring model: list criteria, assign a weight to each by importance, score every option per criterion, multiply score x weight, sum across criteria, then rank by total. Exactly the mechanic M87 teaches (combine several scores into one ranked Top list), expressed in plain decision-making terms a child can follow.

web_results.title: Weighted sum model - Wikipedia
web_results.snippet: Reference for the weighted sum model (WSM/WSUM): overall score = sum of weight_i * value_i across criteria, with the highest total ranked best. Gives the formal formula and the requirement that criteria be on a comparable (normalized) scale before summing - the key step before adding solubility/toxicity/activity/Lipinski scores together.

web_results.title: Multi-parameter optimization: The delicate balancing act of drug discovery (Drug Discovery News)
web_results.snippet: Plain-language feature on why a real drug must simultaneously satisfy potency, ADME, solubility and safety, and how teams (e.g. Pfizer's CNS MPO, a 0-6 desirability index from six properties) score and rank candidates instead of optimizing one property at a time. Good narrative context for why M87 fuses many scores into one Top10 ranking.

youtube_results.title: Finding balance in drug discovery through multi-parameter optimisation
youtube_results.snippet: Short explainer on how a successful drug needs a balance of properties (potency, ADME, toxicity) and how multi-parameter optimisation scores and ranks candidates against a project objective. Visual intuition for combining many scores into one ranking, matching M87's core question.

youtube_results.title: Multi-parameter Optimisation in Practice (Webinar)
youtube_results.snippet: Webinar walking through how a safe, efficacious drug must combine potency with appropriate ADME and toxicity, and how desirability/weighted scoring is applied in practice to prioritize compounds. Reinforces the weighting-and-ranking workflow students build in M87.

exercises.question: 漏斗筛剩的几百个幸存分子, 每个身上带着溶解度分、毒性分、活性分这几个数。直接把这几个数加在一起当总分, 主要的毛病是什么?
options: 加起来太慢, 几百个分子算不过来
几个数量级、方向都不一样, 数最大的那一项会盖住别的项, 总分其实只由它一项说了算
加法本身算错, 应该用减法
分子太少, 加起来没意义
exercises.explanation: 这几项量的是不同的东西、刻度不同、方向有时还相反。溶解度可能在几十上下, 活性概率只在 0 到 1 之间, 硬加的话那个大数把小数全淹了, 你以为在算"综合", 其实只有一项在拿主意。所以相加前必须先归一化。

exercises.question: 毒性是"越大越危险, 越小越好"。在归一化(都压到 0 到 1、越接近 1 越好)的时候, 对毒性这一项要特别多做哪一步?
options: 不用管, 跟别的项一样直接压到 0 到 1
把它从总分里删掉, 不参与排名
把方向翻过来, 让毒性最小的分子拿接近 1 的好评、毒性最大的拿接近 0
exercises.explanation: "越大越好"的项和"越小越好"的项, 不翻方向就没法放一起加。毒性不翻过来的话, 越毒的分子反而总分越高, 整个名次会被它带歪。翻完之后, 四项才统统变成"0 到 1、越大越好"的同一种东西。

exercises.question: 同一堆分子、同一套已经归一化好的分数, 你只把"毒性"这一项的权重调大了一些, 重新算总分再排队。会发生什么?
options: Top10 完全不变, 权重不影响名次
那些特别安全(毒性小)的分子总分上升, 往榜单前面挤, Top10 跟着洗牌
所有分子的总分都变成 0
exercises.explanation: 权重装的是你的偏好。你更看重毒性, 总分这杆秤就更偏向安全的分子, 它们的名次自然往前提。人没变、分数没变, 变的是"什么最重要"的标准, 排出来的前十名就不一样了。

exercises.question: 用你自己的话说清楚: 归一化(把每一项都换算到 0 到 1 的同一把尺子)这一步, 如果偷懒跳过, 为什么特别坑人? 它跟"算出来报个错"的普通 bug 有什么不一样?
exercises.sample_answer: 跳过归一化, 程序不会报错, 总分照样算得出来、Top10 照样排得出来, 看着一切正常。但这串"看起来很专业"的总分其实早被数量级最大的那一项绑架了, 别的项参不参与几乎没区别, 排出来的顺序是错的。它不喊疼、不报警, 你光看结果根本发现不了, 全靠心里清楚"加之前必须先统一尺子"。普通 bug 会崩、会报错, 提醒你去修; 这种错却悄无声息, 还排得理直气壮, 所以更危险。

exercises.question: 漏斗用的是"一票否决"的硬门槛(有一项不达标就直接出局), 这一节的加权综合却允许某一项稍弱。为什么到了"从合格者里挑最好的十个"这一步, 加权综合比硬门槛更合适? 举一个生活里的例子说明。
exercises.sample_answer: 硬门槛太粗暴, 一个综合很强、只在某一项上差一点点的好分子, 会被一刀切掉, 太可惜。加权综合是算总账: 允许某项稍弱, 只要在更重要的几项上够强, 总分照样能排到前面。现实里好东西很少样样满分, 多半是"有短板但整体出色", 加权综合正好能把这种捞出来。生活里的例子: 班级选三好学生, 不会因为某人体育稍弱就直接刷掉, 而是把学习、品德、体育各打个分、按看重程度凑成总评再排——一个学习品德都很突出、体育一般的同学照样能评上。
